en.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword and Control Resonant Headline September 2026 Gaming
en.summary: The gaming landscape is heating up for September 2026 with highly anticipated titles like Onimusha: Way of the Sword and Control Resonant on the horizon. Players are gearing up for a mix of classic revivals and mind-bending new adventures.
en.body:
As September 2026 approaches, the gaming world is abuzz with anticipation for a curated selection of titles poised to dominate playtime. Leading the charge are the eagerly awaited **Onimusha: Way of the Sword** and **Control Resonant**, promising to deliver rich narratives and engaging gameplay mechanics.

**Onimusha: Way of the Sword** marks a significant return for the beloved samurai action-adventure series, expected to land on the Nintendo Switch 2. Fans have long clamored for a new entry, and early indications suggest this installment will honor the franchise's legacy with its signature blend of historical fiction and supernatural elements. Alongside this, **Control Resonant** is set to continue the critically acclaimed **Control** saga, developed by Remedy Entertainment. Building on the unique world and gameplay of its predecessor, this title will delve deeper into the mysteries of the Federal Bureau of Control, with Jesse Faden's brother, Dylan, playing a pivotal role in the unfolding narrative. The game promises another dose of Remedy's signature mind-bending storytelling and environmental puzzle-solving.

## A Glimpse into Player Anticipation

Beyond these major releases, the gaming community is also looking forward to a diverse range of experiences. Titles like **Orbitals**, **Final Fantasy Resonance** (which has already received a hands-on preview with a free demo), and **Metroid Prime 4: Beyond** are generating considerable buzz. The inclusion of **Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition** on the Switch 2 platform also signals a growing trend of major titles finding new life on Nintendo hardware. Furthermore, life and farming simulations continue to be a strong draw, with predictions suggesting at least three such titles could be popular this September.

## What This Means for Gamers

This slate of releases for September 2026 speaks volumes about the current gaming landscape. It highlights a strong demand for both the revival of classic franchises and the continuation of critically lauded modern series. The focus on narrative depth, as seen in **Control Resonant**, and the strategic action of **Onimusha: Way of the Sword**, caters to a broad spectrum of players, from those seeking intricate stories to those who enjoy challenging combat. The continued support for the Nintendo Switch 2 platform with major third-party releases also underscores its growing importance in the market.

## Looking Ahead

With **Final Fantasy Resonance** already offering a demo, players have a tangible taste of what's to come. While official release dates for many of these highly anticipated titles are still solidifying, the sheer volume of excitement suggests a packed and rewarding end to the summer gaming season. Players should keep a close eye on official announcements for **Onimusha: Way of the Sword** and **Control Resonant** as more details emerge throughout the year.
